# TPC-DS-OBT Q76

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT channel, col_name, sold_date_d_year, sold_date_d_qoy, item_i_category, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, SUM(ext_sales_price) AS sales_amt FROM (SELECT 'store' AS channel, 'ship_customer_sk' AS col_name, obt.sold_date_d_year, obt.sold_date_d_qoy, obt.item_i_category, obt.ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (ship_customer_sk IS NULL AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk) AND channel = 'store' UNION ALL SELECT 'web' AS channel, 'bill_customer_sk' AS col_name, obt.sold_date_d_year, obt.sold_date_d_qoy, obt.item_i_category, obt.ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (bill_customer_sk IS NULL AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk) AND channel = 'web' UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, 'bill_customer_sk' AS col_name, obt.sold_date_d_year, obt.sold_date_d_qoy, obt.item_i_category, obt.ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (bill_customer_sk IS NULL AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk) AND channel = 'catalog') AS foo GROUP BY channel, col_name, sold_date_d_year, sold_date_d_qoy, item_i_category ORDER BY channel, col_name, sold_date_d_year, sold_date_d_qoy, item_i_category LIMIT 100
```
